fieldValues.title: Minutes taken in a meeting cannot point at the words they came from
fieldValues.statement: While a meeting is being recorded and transcribed, the person taking minutes in the browser cannot see the transcript arrive beside their editor, and a minute they write cannot be connected to the moment of conversation it came from. The connection is lost, or has to be rebuilt by hand afterwards.
source_ref: Owner, 2026-11-05 (vignette 248620b9): "I would probably also be working with an editor in the browser - possibly taking minutes that I want to connect with the transcript?"
